C9000299.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 299 (The Kirchberg–Rørdam character criterion and infinite tensor-power Jiang–Su stability.; papers: The Kirchberg–Rørdam character criterion; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/299.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_CONE_DROP.statement: For every nonzero unital complex C*-algebra P and unital eta from the unitized M2 cone with full eta(t e11), a finite maximal tensor power contains the exact equivalent orthogonal pair and fixed-cutoff defect comparison of prop:cone-drop.

C_CONE_GENERAL.statement: For every d>=2, full rank-one corner of a unital unitized Md-cone map into any nonzero unital P gives d exact equivalent orthogonal positive contractions in P tensor_max (N^L+L), for every L>=1 with d^L>=N, whose defect is Cuntz below every fixed cutoff (b1-lambda)+, 0<lambda<1.

C_CONE_FULLCUT.statement: Every full positive contraction in a nonzero unital C*-algebra has a cut c=(b-delta)+ and an exact finite-column witness 1=V*diag(c,...,c)V.

C_CONE_SIMPLEX.statement: In every finite dimension k the recursive partial-flip construction gives continuous unital matrix embeddings supported on exactly the available simplex faces, including the terminal vertex.

C_CONE_CUBE.statement: The maximal tensor power of the unitized matrix cone is the continuous cubical section algebra with scalar zero-coordinate boundary fibers.

C_CONE_SUPPORT.statement: For every d>=2,k>=1 and delta in (0,1), the cubical formulas define d exactly equivalent orthogonal positive contractions, continuous at the origin, with defect X and orthogonal Y=sum yj satisfying a1 Y=Y and k[X]<=N[Y].

C_CONE_AMPLIFICATION.statement: For every d>=2,N>=1 and every L>=1 with d^L>=N, put e=c tensor L,k=N^L,m=k+L. Then N[e]<=[1]<=k[e] removes the comparison multiplicities by tensoring, without cancellation.

C_CONE_FORMAL.statement: Universal algebraic, scalar-boundary, and ordered-tensor core identities underlying the cone construction have proof-hole-free machine-checkable supporting proofs.

C_FULL_CONE.statement: The tensor-label and full square-zero construction in tensor.tex gives a full cone corner in a finite maximal tensor power of any unital characterless algebra.

C_FINITE.statement: Theorem thm:finite: every nonzero unital complex characterless C*-algebra has a unital I(2,3) map into a finite maximal tensor power.

C_RW.statement: Rordam-Winter Proposition 5.1(ii) implies (iv), in the n=2 case, without a stable-rank-one hypothesis.

C_MAIN.statement: Theorem thm:main follows from the finite construction, separable reduction, and the precise Kirchberg-Rordam central-sequence inputs.

C_KR.statement: The same-unit commuting-copies lemma and the subhomogeneous central-sequence absorption criterion apply with the manuscript's stated quantifiers.

C_INFINITE.statement: The infinite minimal tensor-power corollary follows from the finite map, the maximal-to-minimal quotient, and Dadarlat-Toms Theorem 1.1.

C_DT.statement: Dadarlat-Toms Theorem 1.1 applies to the same-unit subhomogeneous characterless image in the infinite minimal tensor power.
